plugins.name: bootstrapp
plugins.description: Use bootstrapp.cloud as a backend for apps you build with Claude Code. Wires up the bootstrapp.cloud MCP server plus scaffolding commands, usage skills, design and implementation agents, and helpers for named views and on-demand filter calls.

plugins.name: bootstrapp-kit
plugins.description: Flexible BootstrApp toolkit: skills, commands and agents to model ObjectTypes, define actions, write ApiScripts and generate typed clients, for new apps and for existing apps moving their backend to BootstrApp.
